source.author: verg
source.text: Bis septem Rutuli, muros qui milite servent, delecti; ast illos centeni quemque sequuntur purpurei cristis iuvenes auroque corusci.
source.text_original: Bis septem Rutuli, muros qui milite servent, / delecti; ast illos centeni quemque sequuntur / purpurei cristis iuvenes auroque corusci.
source.text_english: Twice seven Rutulians, chosen to guard the walls with soldiers; but each of those is followed by a hundred young men, gleaming with purple crests and shining with gold.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sacer effera raptet corda pavor; nee sola mei gravia affore nati arma ratemque putet: classes et Pontica signa atque indignatos temerato litore reges mente agitet semperque metu decurrat ad undas arena ciens; mors sera viam temptataque claudat effugia et nostras nequeat praecurrere diras, sed reduces iam iamque viros auroque coruscum cernat iter.
reuse.text_original: sacer effera raptet / corda pavor; nee sola mei gravia affore nati / arma ratemque putet: classes et Pontica signa / atque indignatos temerato litore reges / mente agitet semperque metu decurrat ad undas / arena ciens; mors sera viam temptataque claudat / effugia et nostras nequeat praecurrere diras, / sed reduces iam iamque viros auroque coruscum / cernat iter.
reuse.text_english: Let savage terror seize their sacred hearts; let her not think that only the weighty arms and ship of my son are at hand: let her keep stirring in her mind fleets and Pontic standards and kings angered by the desecrated shore, and let her ever run down to the waves in fear, summoning the sand; let death, delayed, block the way and the attempted escape routes, and be unable to outstrip my curses, but let her see the men now returning, and the road shining with gold.
